plain_definition: A person or firm registered with the CFTC that operates a pooled investment vehicle -- a 'commodity pool' -- trading in futures, options, or swaps on behalf of investors. Some exchange-traded funds that invest in bitcoin futures contracts, rather than in bitcoin itself, are structured this way, with the fund's sponsor registered as the pool's commodity pool operator.
formal_definition: Commodity Exchange Act Section 1a(11) (7 U.S.C. 1a(11)) defines 'commodity pool operator.' CFTC Regulation 4.10(d) (17 CFR 4.10(d)) defines 'commodity pool.' A commodity pool operator must generally register with the CFTC, through the National Futures Association, under Commodity Exchange Act Section 4m (7 U.S.C. 6m), unless an exemption applies.
